    Class Description
    SafeBeam
    A light beam (direct or diffuse used in the tree light interception process )
    SafeBeamSet<T>
    A light beam set composed of direct or diffuse beams.
    SafeCell
    SafeCell is a square spatial division of a SafePlot A collection of SafeVoxel is composing the SafeCell soil A SafeCrop related to a SafeCropZone is attached to each SafeCell
    SafeCell.Immutable2
    4 neighbor cells used for toric symmetry
    SafeCrop
    SafeCrop represent the crop sowed on a SafeCell (can be baresoil) Only one SafeCrop is created by SafeCell (state variables of the crop are homogenous) Crop model is implemented by STICS (calling fortran native method)
    SafeCropSpecies
    Crop species parameters Hi-sAFe specific STICS usual parameters are in safe.stics.SafeSticsCrop
    SafeCropZone
    Crop zone description : A collection of SafeCell with the same crop species SafeCropSpecies The list of itk file name (containing crop intervention calendar) is read in the sim file

    SafeMethodProvider
    Method provider for mountain module, extends default method provider for MaddModels.
    SafeModel
    SafeModel is the main class for Hi-sAFe List of main methods loadInitStand : load the pld file loadGeneralParameter : load the hisafe and stics general parameters file loadWeather : load the weather file loadExport : load export parameters initializeModel : create and initialize all objects (stand soil voxels plot cells crops trees) projectJustOpened : reopen a saved project processEvolution : simulation loop from dayStart to dayEnd processGrowth : daily loop growth for trees and crop export : create and file export file
    SafePedotransferUtil
    Pedotransfer functions for hydraulic properties of soil (adapted from Wosten et al., 1998)
    SafePlantRoot
    PLANT (Tree of crop) roots system
    SafePlantRoot.Immutable  
    SafePlot
    SafePlot represent the spatial desagregation of the SafeStand on a grid
    SafePlotSettings
    PLOT parameters
    SafeRootNode
    SafeRootNode is used to build tree and crop coarse roots topology Each node is liked to its parent node and to its colonized nodes to design a tree-like topology
    SafeShadingMask
    A collection of SafeShadingNeighbour (used for light interception by crops)
    SafeShadingNeighbour
    Used for light interception by crops Contains : a neigbour cell, its relative coordinates, and informations about the path of a beam above this cell (distance to impact point of entrance and exit points)
    SafeSoil
    Soil general description
    SafeStand
    STAND description (collection of trees)
    SafeTestJNA
    SafeTestJNA is the class for calling native functions in STICS FORTRAN via JNA Available native functions are : ================================= verifParam : general parameters initialization verification verifPlant : plants and itk parameters initialization verification initClimat : climatic data initialization annualLoopStart : annual loop initialization addLitterInSoil : add carbon litters from tree (branches, stem, leaves, roots) dailyLoopPart1 : daily loop part 1 dailyLoopPart2 : daily loop part 2 annualLoopEnd : annual loop end process
